description: This file defines the absl::FunctionRef template class, a lightweight, non-owning reference wrapper for invokable objects with a specific signature. It provides mechanisms to construct from various invokable types, including function pointers and functors, and emphasizes usage as an argument type to avoid lifetime issues. The class is designed for efficiency, avoiding allocations and deep copies, and is intended for use cases similar to std::function but with different ownership and performance characteristics.

classes.name: absl::FunctionRef<R(Args...)>
classes.description: A lightweight, non-owning reference wrapper for any invokable object with a compatible signature, designed for use as an argument type to avoid ownership and lifetime issues.

methods.name: FunctionRef(const F& f)
methods.description: Constructs a FunctionRef from any invokable type, ensuring compatibility with the signature.

methods.name: FunctionRef(F* f)
methods.description: Constructs a FunctionRef from a function pointer, avoiding an extra level of indirection.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Invokes the wrapped invokable object with provided arguments.
